output.subject: We've received your complaint about your debit card while traveling
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for calling us and for taking the time to explain what happened. We know how stressful it is to have your card stop working while you're away from home, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

We have your complaint. Here are the main points as you described them:

- You told us that while you were in Montreal, your debit card kept being declined from the morning onward, after an alert was triggered on a hotel transaction.
- You mentioned that you replied "yes" to our fraud text alert twice, but your card was still declined afterward.
- You asked that your card be usable while you're traveling.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint, and we will respond within 10 business days.

If anything here doesn't match your experience, or you'd like to add any details, please reply to this message and we'll include it in the review.

Thank you again for bringing this to our attention.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Confirm the block was removed and the travel note through 9/7 is active before sending; consider adding that the card should now work if confirmed.
The call note says the customer was told text replies can take time to process; the exact timeframe in the note was obscured by a redaction token, so verify before mentioning it.
Check whether the customer's two 'yes' replies were received and why they did not clear the block.
Note records no fees and no disputed transactions; confirm nothing else needs addressing.
Customer may still be traveling; consider whether a faster contact is warranted.
